_comment: Baseline experiment configuration. These are starting values for ONE controlled experiment, not claimed optima. Training scripts load this file and allow CLI overrides; every run logs the effective values actually used.

model._comment: Apache-2.0, ungated. Qwen2ForCausalLM (native in transformers). SDPA because FlashAttention-2 does not support the T4 (sm_75).

quantization._comment: QLoRA demonstration: NF4 frozen base weights + double quantization. Compute dtype is float16 because the T4 has no bf16 support. A 0.5B model does NOT require 4-bit to fit on a T4; quantization is used to demonstrate the technique under the assignment constraint.

lora._comment: Candidates only. train_qlora.py inspects the loaded model, prints every Linear/Linear4bit module name, and builds target_modules from candidates that actually exist. Any missing candidate is a hard error. Baseline = attention projections only (decision F); adding MLP projections would be a separate single-variable run.

sft._comment: Effective batch = micro_batch_size x gradient_accumulation_steps = 16. lr 2e-4 and max_grad_norm 0.3 follow common QLoRA practice. optim adamw_torch: optimizer state for ~2M adapter params is only a few MB, so paged 8-bit optimizers are not needed at baseline.

dpo._sft_adapter_note: Pass --sft-adapter-dir explicitly (the restored copy of the logged baseline SFT final_adapter). Its adapter_model.safetensors must hash to expected_sft_adapter_sha256, which must also equal the adapter_sha256 of the completed baseline row sft_run_id in logs/experiment_log.csv. Never outputs/smoke_adapter/.
dpo._comment: Short DPO pass after SFT. Policy = the SFT adapter loaded trainable as 'default'. Reference = TRL 1.14's built-in frozen copy of that adapter under the name 'ref' (DPOTrainer with a PeftModel and ref_model=None), on the same 4-bit base, NOT the adapter-disabled base and NOT a merged model. TRL 1.14 has no model_adapter_name/ref_adapter_name config fields (verified in source). policy_adapter_dtype=fp32 undoes TRL's quantized-model bf16 cast of the trainable adapter so the policy starts bit-identical to the SFT adapter (see README 7.4).

preference_mix._comment: A+B (60) = no-address complaints, rejected invents an address; C (60) = exact-address controls, rejected returns null; D (30) = exact-address controls, rejected alters the house number. Null appears in 60 chosen and 60 rejected responses so null alone carries no preference signal.

data._comment: Split is by scenario FAMILY (whole families go to one side) and stratified: 5 eval examples per category, 4 eval examples per no-address location condition (6 conditions -> 24 eval no-address). Overall no-address = 6 x (6 + 4) = 60 / 400 = 15%.

evaluation._frozen_scoring_note: SHA-256 of scripts/eval_scoring.py, frozen before any GPU evaluation. evaluate_models.py refuses to run if the file differs.
evaluation._comment: Greedy decoding, batch size 1 (no padding effects), identical prompts/template/settings/order/scoring for all three states. model.generation_config is REPLACED by this explicit greedy config because Qwen ships do_sample=True/temperature/top_k/top_p/repetition_penalty=1.1 defaults that transformers merges into unset fields. BASE = same NF4 base with adapters disabled; SFT/DPO = verified adapters on that base, switched in place (no merge). Numerics mirror training: prepare_model_for_kbit_training upcasts non-4-bit params to fp32; generation runs under fp16 autocast.
